label: Swaps: tilapia + basil, 100 m2, Karnataka polyhouse: architecture, heating and part swaps side by side
_how_to_edit: Each option is a patch on the base build (dicts merge, lists and values replace). Part alternatives from the catalog are added automatically (include_component_alternatives).

base._location: Wage and electricity come from data/scenarios/unit_configuration_candidates_v0.json (locations block).
base._structure_area_basis: planning_area_m2_uvi_ratio (grow area x UVI land ratio) or minimum_area_m2 (grow area + equipment footprint).

options.label: Media bed with expanded clay (LECA) instead of DWC raft
options.note: LECA priced from four IndiaMART sellers (Rs 9,500-18,760/m3, candidate). Configurator still adds an MBBR biofilter for media beds (media nitrification not credited). No sourced media-bed yield, and clay lifetime and bed container are not sourced.
options.confidence_reason: Feed and fish fall to 25% of the raft rate on one SRAC sentence (low confidence); no sourced media-bed basil yield; clay lifetime and bed container not sourced.
options.risk: Beds clog with solids and need labour-intensive washing (FAO 589); the media doubles as solids filter and biofilter in small systems.
options.labour: Washing clogged media; no raft handling.

options.label: NFT with uPVC channels instead of DWC raft
options.note: Yield = DWC yield x 0.83-0.95 (Blunk 2023, Pasch 2021; candidate). Channel metres per m2 not sourced, so channel cost is a gap.
options.confidence_reason: NFT yield is 0.83-0.95 of raft from two studies that disagree on size (pending Batch 003); fish feed at 25% of the raft rate is a low-confidence rule; channels and biofilter not fully priced.
options.risk: Most sensitive to pump stops: a thin film dries out within hours, while a raft holds water. Needs fine solids removal and a separate biofilter.
options.labour: Channels need flushing and root clearing after each crop.

options.label: Fan-and-pad polyhouse instead of naturally ventilated (MIDH 2025 norm)
options.note: Lifetime and fan/pad electricity not sourced, so the annual cost is understated.
options.confidence_reason: MIDH 2025 norm price (Tier 1, a subsidy ceiling), but lifetime and fan/pad electricity are not sourced, so the cost change has the wrong sign until they are.
options.risk: Cooler in summer; a power cut stops the cooling.
options.labour: Pads need cleaning and replacing; fans need servicing.

options.label: Add propagation plugs or tray cells for every plant start
options.note: NL: Grodan stone wool cubes; India: seedling-tray cells counted as single use, cocopeat fill not priced.
options.confidence_reason: Tray reuse and cocopeat fill are not sourced, so the direction of the error is unknown.
options.risk: Even germination and fewer losses (not quantified).
options.labour: Sowing and transplanting time not sourced.

options.label: Add battery backup for pumps and aeration
options.note: Sized on the summed power of the chosen pumps and air pumps. Lifetime not sourced, so the yearly cost is a gap (*).
options.confidence_reason: Clear current price (Tier 3), but no sourced lifetime or runtime need.
options.risk: Keeps fish alive through routine power cuts.

options.label: Add a DO meter, pH meter and test kit
options.note: One of each per system. Lifetimes not sourced, so the yearly cost is a gap (*).
options.risk: Catches low oxygen and pH drift early.
options.labour: Daily and weekly checks (minutes not sourced).

options.label: Add a UV steriliser
options.note: One unit per system; flow rating not read. India unit is an RO-type stand-in with no sourced lifetime (*).
options.risk: Clearer water; UVI ran without UV, so it is optional.
